test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Neither of them have / any experience / in software development.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'Neither of them have'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'Neither of them has' **should be used instead o**f 'Neither of them have'.**
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is: 
 
 
• Neither of + Plural Noun/Pronoun+Singular Verb.
 
 
• *Example*: *Neither of them looks after him.*
 
 
 
• *​*Either of + Plural Noun/Pronoun+Singular Verb.
 
 
• *Example*: *Either of them is at fault.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the above structures '**has**' should be used.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***Neither of them has **any experience in software development.*
